description: This file contains a test class 'LeaveRequestDaoTest' that extends KernelTestCase, used to test the LeaveRequestDao class in the OrangeHRM human resource management system. It includes various unit tests for methods related to leave request handling, such as retrieving leave by ID, checking overlapping leaves, calculating total leave duration, saving leave requests (with and without entitlements), changing leave status, and fetching employee leave data. The class utilizes fixtures and mock services for testing database interactions and entity relationships, and contains utility methods for comparing data objects and mocking database queries.

classes.name: LeaveRequestDaoTest
classes.description: Test suite for the LeaveRequestDao class, covering methods related to leave request retrieval, creation, status updates, and entitlement management.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test environment, creates an instance of LeaveRequestDao, loads fixture data, and mocks services.

methods.name: testGetLeaveById
methods.description: Verifies fetching a leave by its ID returns a Leave object with correct attributes.

methods.name: testGetOverlappingLeaveMultipleFullDayLeave
methods.description: Tests retrieval of multiple overlapping full-day leave objects within a date range.

methods.name: testGetOverlappingLeaveInSameDay1
methods.description: Checks overlapping leave detection in a same-day scenario with specific start and end times.

methods.name: testGetTotalLeaveDuration
methods.description: Parameterized test for calculating total leave duration for given employee and date.

methods.name: testSaveLeaveRequestNewRequestNoEntitlement
methods.description: Validates saving a new leave request without entitlements and checks database consistency.

methods.name: testSaveLeaveRequestNewRequestWithEntitlement
methods.description: Validates saving a new leave request with associated entitlements and verifies data integrity.

methods.name: testSaveLeaveRequestNewRequestWithEntitlementChanges
methods.description: Tests saving a leave request with changes to entitlements, including usage updates and database reflection.

methods.name: testSaveLeaveRequestNewRequestWithEntitlementChangesAndTakenLeave
methods.description: Ensures updating a leave request with entitlement changes and recorded taken leave updates the database correctly.

methods.name: testChangeLeaveStatusNoEntitlementChanges
methods.description: Tests changing leave status to cancelled without altering entitlements, verifying state consistency.

methods.name: testChangeLeaveStatusEntitlementChangesRemoveLinked
methods.description: Tests changing leave status with entitlement modifications and removal of linked entitlement assignments.

methods.name: getEmployeesInSubUnits
methods.description: Retrieves employee numbers under specified subunits from fixture data.

methods.name: testGetLeaveRequestsForEmployees
methods.description: Verifies retrieval of leave requests filtered by employee numbers.
